response.sql: WITH funding_sources AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS source_size, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_y_to_z_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), size_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(source_size) AS avg_source_size FROM funding_sources) SELECT AVG(f.avg_y_to_z_ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(f.source_size) AS combined_size, AVG(f.source_size - b.avg_source_size) AS avg_size_excess FROM funding_sources AS f CROSS JOIN size_benchmark AS b WHERE f.source_size > b.avg_source_size;
